title: Legislative districts of Biliran
wikitext:
{{Short description|Districts of Philippine province}} {{Politics of the Philippines}} The '''legislative districts of Biliran''' are the representations of the [[Provinces of the Philippines|province]] of [[Biliran]] in the [[Congress of the Philippines]]. The province is currently represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|lower house]] of the Congress through its [[Biliran's at-large congressional district|lone congressional district]].
